title: EquiPocket: an E(3)-Equivariant Geometric Graph Neural Network for Ligand Binding Site Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2302.12177v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Predicting the binding sites of target proteins plays a fundamental role in drug discovery. Most existing deep-learning methods consider a protein as a 3D image by spatially clustering its atoms into voxels and then feed the voxelized protein into a 3D CNN for prediction. However, the CNN-based methods encounter several critical issues: 1) defective in representing irregular protein structures; 2) sensitive to rotations; 3) insufficient to characterize the protein surface; 4) unaware of protein size shift. To address the above issues, this work proposes EquiPocket, an E(3)-equivariant Graph Neural Network (GNN) for binding site prediction, which comprises three modules: the first one to extract local geometric information for each surface atom, the second one to model both the chemical and spatial structure of protein and the last one to capture the geometry of the surface via equivariant message passing over the surface atoms.

translated_title: EquiPocket：一种用于配体结合位点预测的E(3)-等变几何图神经网络
translated_abstract: 预测目标蛋白的结合位点在药物发现中扮演着基础性角色。现有的大多数深度学习方法通过将蛋白原子的空间聚类为体素，将蛋白视为3D图像，然后将体素化的蛋白输入3D CNN进行预测。然而，基于CNN的方法遇到几个关键问题：1）在表示不规则蛋白结构方面存在缺陷；2）对旋转敏感；3）不足以表征蛋白表面；4）未意识到蛋白大小变化。为解决上述问题，本工作提出了EquiPocket，一种用于结合位点预测的E(3)-等变图神经网络（GNN），它包含三个模块：第一个模块用于提取每个表面原子的局部几何信息，第二个模块用于建模蛋白的化学和空间结构，最后一个模块通过表面原子上的等变消息传递来捕获表面的几何形状。
tldr: 提出了一种E(3)-等变图神经网络EquiPocket，通过三个模块（局部几何提取、化学空间建模、表面等变消息传递）解决了基于CNN方法在结合位点预测中的不规则结构、旋转敏感、表面表征不足和大小变化问题。
en_tdlr: Proposed an E(3)-equivariant graph neural network, EquiPocket, with three modules (local geometric extraction, chemical-spatial modeling, and surface equivariant message passing) to address CNN-based limitations in binding site prediction, including irregular structures, rotation sensitivity, insufficient surface characterization, and size shift.
